name: Mel
source:
A homunculus girl who is desperately trying to make her "dream" come true.

Before being picked up by [url=/c112744]Rakels[/url], she was sent to the battlefield as a "tool" for the army. After the war was over, they no longer needed her, so she was sold to a certain merchant as a "commodity." Since the homunculus has a short lifespan, no one was willing to spend a lot of money on a product that would be expired soon, so she remained unsold. No longer wanting to carry this baggage, the merchant dumped Mel at a landfill in the forest.

A few days later, Rakels happened to be passing by the landfill. He met Mel, and took her with him.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1191196&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
